morning.headline: Futures Dip as Traders Brace for CPI and FOMC Data
morning.summary: US index futures are trading lower this morning, extending yesterday's weakness, with the Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.45%. Overnight, Asian markets showed mixed results, but semiconductor stocks like SoftBank and SK Hynix saw significant declines. The VIX is elevated, and the CNN Fear & Greed index remains in fear territory. Key levels to watch for SPY are 722.59 support and 760.4 resistance, while QQQ faces support at 686.37 and resistance at 748.65. Today's CPI data and upcoming FOMC decision will be critical.

afternoon.headline: Market Tumbles on Weakening Breadth and Negative Gamma.
afternoon.summary: US equities closed sharply lower, led by significant declines in the Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500, with broad market weakness evident in the advancers/decliners ratio. Semis were the notable laggard sector, while industrials also saw substantial losses. Both SPY and QQQ are now in short gamma territory, suggesting dealers will amplify downward price movements. The VIX rose, and the CNN Fear & Greed index fell into fear territory.

highlights.label: Indexes Drop
highlights.text: SPY fell 1.57%, QQQ dropped 2.00%, and IWM declined 1.07% on heavy selling pressure.

highlights.label: Sector Weakness
highlights.text: Semis lagged significantly, down 3.55%, with SMCI plunging 27.98% on high volume.

highlights.label: Negative Gamma
highlights.text: Both SPY and QQQ are in short gamma positions, with dealers expected to accelerate market moves.

highlights.label: Fear Gauge
highlights.text: The VIX increased 9.71% to 21.80, and the Fear & Greed index dropped to 28.

highlights.label: Options Flow
highlights.text: Unusual put activity was seen in SMH and AAPL, while TSLA call buyers were active.

highlights.label: Upcoming Data
highlights.text: Traders will watch ADBE and LEN earnings tomorrow, alongside PPI data.
